about_short_description.short_description: Excellence Learning is a management consulting company that offers application programs and administrative training services.

product.name: Project Management Professional (PMP)®
product.description: A course designed to prepare participants for the PMP certification, offering training and support to help them pass the exam.

product.name: Change Management Professional (CCMP)
product.description: A program focused on equipping participants with skills to manage organizational change effectively, aligned with global standards.

product.name: Strategic Planning Professional (SPP)
product.description: A course providing insights into strategic planning, helping organizations assess their current status and plan future directions.

product.name: Program Management Professional (PgMP)®
product.description: Training that covers skills and practices necessary for managing programs to achieve strategic benefits.

product.name: Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP)®
product.description: A program that teaches skills for managing portfolios to align with organizational strategic goals.

product.name: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
product.description: A course on Lean management and Six Sigma methodologies, preparing participants for the Green Belt certification.
